## Connection sequence

1. RDP to 10.70.115.36:3389 as operator1; use saved reference `procedure-00000000000000000000000000000000-hop-1.rdp.pw`. Opened from runner desktop.
2. RDP to 172.20.33.215:3389 as jamuser; use saved reference `procedure-00000000000000000000000000000000-hop-2.rdp.pw`. Opened from RDP desktop from hop 1 (Windows Remote Desktop inside the previous desktop).

Hops 2..N are opened inside the previous desktop with Windows Remote Desktop. Hop 1 is opened from the runner desktop; only saved reference names are recorded here.

All operating commands, browser localhost URLs, and COM-port checks below apply inside the final RDP desktop (hop 2), not on the dashboard server or the first desktop.


## Procedure

### Confirm the PowerShell session is elevated

Type: procedure-step

1. Confirm the PowerShell session is elevated
Open Windows PowerShell as Administrator: right-click Windows PowerShell and choose "Run as administrator". If a User Account Control box asks only Yes/No, choose Yes; if it asks for a user name or password, stop and report it.

- The current token is elevated: IsInRole(Administrator) returns True. Otherwise stop and reopen PowerShell as administrator.

### Stop the service

Type: procedure-step; mutating

2. Stop the service
Stop-Service -Name JAMboreeVision

- The named Windows service reaches Stopped before any hardware work.

### Confirm it is stopped

Type: procedure-step

3. Confirm it is stopped

must show Stopped

Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5004
